decisions.reason: The platform dimensions provide clearance beneath the existing flush-mounted spouts but do not change their geometry, orientation, material, or mounting location.
The source specifies platform height, cup clearance, and footprint without changing valve control, flow behavior, feed method, or dispensing sequence.
Platform and cup-clearance dimensions do not alter the requirement for a removable or easily cleaned dispensing path.
The raised base configuration does not change the required sealing behavior of the plumbing or spout connection.
The source does not modify liquid containment or isolation of electrical components.
The height and footprint of the separate support base do not necessarily change bowl removal, swapping, or internal removal clearance.
The source does not change whisk selection, whisk positioning relative to the bowls, mixing quality, or frothing performance.
Making the platform match the machine footprint does not alter placard wording, placement, or viewing orientation.
The external support-base height does not change whisk detachment behavior, tool-free preference, or clearance for bowl removal.
The 12 oz value describes cups beneath the spouts, not the mixing bowls, and the source does not change bowl capacity, depth, or geometry.
The source establishes support-base dimensions and cup clearance without changing splash targets or mitigation methods.
The support base's color and font treatment were already established; the later dimensional specification does not modify those visual attributes.
